prompt:

Art direction: Fase 2 usando como referencia obligatoria la Fase 1 aprobada. Paleta fría/neutra de Edran: verdes agrícolas apagados, gris azulado y tierra parda; trigo pálido solo como acento menor.

Prompt: Create one 1536x1024 landscape wildlife scene with safe center in the Llanos de Edran. Preserve the approved reference anatomy exactly: one complete Velozanco with SIX supports in a 4+2 plan. Four long slender locomotor legs carry a lightweight HORIZONTAL SUSPENDED TORSO; two additional short anterior supports are clearly visible as small weight-bearing legs, not arms. CRITICAL SILHOUETTE: make the animal unmistakably non-dinosaurian. Use a compact blunt non-reptilian head set almost directly into the front of the torso, virtually no visible neck, no dinosaur snout, no theropod chest, no raptor posture, and no heavy hindquarters. Distribute visual weight across all four long locomotor legs rather than emphasizing a rear pair.
